assumptions.statement: The submitted site and three key-area polygons are provisional rough geometries derived from the repository site package, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All areas, overlaps, project locations, drawings, and HTML must be recalculated when official polygons are published.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines, ownership, utilities, fire, flood, heritage, and underground conditions are not available as official controls.
assumptions.impact: The proposal uses known/proposed/pending labels and makes no statutory or engineering claim.

assumptions.statement: The Public Exchange Ticket, twelve touchpoints, and annual operating cycle are governance proposals, not commitments by named institutions.
assumptions.impact: Responsible operators, access permission, professional review, and public participation are required before any pilot.

assumptions.statement: The light-experience protocol, experience rights, moment-specific AI services, default-off operation, session erasure, and non-digital fallbacks are design proposals, not claims about existing city platforms.
assumptions.impact: Any pilot requires privacy and personal-information review, cyber-security review, accessibility review, transport-operator and merchant coordination, public participation, an accountable human owner, and a tested non-digital fallback.
